text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon got injured during training, 
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I really don't need any first aid. 
Getting a little hurt happens all the 
time.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's a waste of time, so... Let's just get 
back to training already.
choice_data_list: I'm worried, so let me treat that.
Let's stay focused and get to practice.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I told you you're exaggerating... Ow.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
No... well, it hurt a little, but it's 
nothing that won't heal on its own!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Can't be worrying over minor injuries. 
Sometimes you've gotta push through, 
right?
choice_data_list:
What if an injured junior said the same 
thing to you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course I'd scold them and make 
them rest!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Aah, damn it. I get what you're trying 
to say.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Resting just to be safe... that should be 
fine, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing the treatment, I had her 
rest thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I know! I can't look pathetic in front of 
my juniors any longer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I need to gauge my own condition properly—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ow, ow, ow... Boy, this is rough.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Walking was fine, but running is a whole 
different story, huh...
choice_data_list: Let's rest and heal up properly.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Damn it, fine, I get it. Can't go letting 
it get worse in front of the 
underclassmen, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suppressing her restless urge, Hishi 
Amazon decided to take a rest.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I need to gauge my own condition properly—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry, Trainy, I take back what I said 
earlier. Could you tape me up after all?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't say it hurts, exactly, but it 
does feel a bit off.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If we're returning to practice, we need to 
ensure everything is in perfect order.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
After all, I'm the one always telling my 
juniors never to take an injury lightly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the thorough taping, she was 
able to continue her training without any 
issues.
